prototypeScope: V1.18 delta package: only the D-010 battery backpack frame and cap on one Orange plate. V1.17 is the printed baseline (Shawn started printing it on 2026-10-15: "1.18可以把1.17里面剔除掉"), so none of its parts are re-issued.
knownFitBoundary: Shells need the V1.9 rear pack (its shoulder bars); Shawn confirmed it is fitted. The pack bar has no printed pilot: drill dia 1.6 through the shell roof hole with a tape flag 7.0 mm from the tip. Driver above each pack screw on the finished robot: 57.8 mm to the lower head shell. Cap: closes with the same three ROBOTIS M2.6 x 6 as the V1.9 cap; the A7Z rests on the four round pads and screws on with the Pi screws (E-pi-01..04). Face: the camera takes 4 x M2 x 4 into 2.4 mm of thread (below the 3.5 mm target, face-a7z/README.md) and the eye trim 2 x M2 x 6 from the face back; the image needs a 90 deg rotation in software. Thighs: same geometry as the 10/1 thighs; fitting them means taking both legs apart and re-reading the joint zeros (guide/firmware/mac/pose_snapshot.py). Battery backpack: built for the Tattu 2S 650 listing size (57 x 31 x 12 mm) in a 58 x 32 x 13 pocket; measure the pack before printing if it may be larger. It mounts on the same four cover screws as the rear converter box (swap one for the other); cap 3 x M2 x 6, fixing 4 x M2 x 6.
processOverrideReason: No process overrides: the White cap overrides of V1.12-V1.17 apply to the White plate, which V1.18 does not carry.
